description: Update README.md to document the new per-match submit control on all three stages, the cumulative-standings popup, the final-match fullscreen total ranking, and the REVISED extra-games rule (boundary-bubble folding). The current 'Extra games' section states regulation totals and averages do NOT change; that is no longer true for the tied bubble and must be corrected. Depends on FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Read README.md sections 'Tournament flow', 'Extra games', and 'Saving and recovery'.

Document that each stage (To Live 5 games, To Die 8 matches, Rebirth 10 games) has a per-match 'Submit Match N of X' control; submitting a non-final match shows a dismissible popup with cumulative round standings through that match; submitting the final match shows a fullscreen total round ranking with ADVANCE/CUT/TIE.

Rewrite the 'Extra games' section to describe the boundary-bubble model: only the players tied across the cut line play extra games; their extra-game goals FOLD INTO their total and recompute their average (state the exact formula: average = (regulation goals + extra goals) / (regulation matches + extra matches)); re-ranking is contained to the tied bubble so a cut/tied player can overtake a tied-advancing player, but players never in the tie keep their places; if still tied, add another extra game for the remaining tied subgroup. Note the final's extra games use normal scoring (no games 1-2 multiplier) and fold points similarly.
Keep the no-dependencies / version-4 / backup notes accurate. Do not contradict the engine behavior implemented in FEAT-002.
Confirm no code is changed in this feature; it is docs-only.
acceptance_criteria: README documents the per-match submit control for all three stages, the popup, and the fullscreen.
README's extra-games section describes the boundary-bubble folding with the exact average formula and no longer claims regulation averages/totals never change.
No source files changed by this feature (docs only).
verification: grep for 'boundary' or the average formula in README.md confirms the revised rule is documented
git diff --name-only shows only README.md changed by this feature
findings:
Docs-only. README.md is the ONLY file changed (git diff --name-only shows README.md). Committed on feat/per-match-ranking as 5f6fce8. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests = 40 OK; node tests/test_ui.cjs exit 0 (confirmed nothing else moved).

ADDED a new subsection under 'Tournament flow' titled 'Per-match submit, standings popup, and final fullscreen'. It documents: each round has a per-match 'Submit Match N of X' control (To Live 5 games, To Die 8 matches, Rebirth 10 games), disabled until the match is ready (all active scores incl. zeroes) and not stale; submitting a NON-final match opens a dismissible popup with CUMULATIVE round standings through that match (rank, name, running total, average, provisional status), summed over matches played so far; submitting the FINAL match opens a fullscreen total round ranking for all players with totals/averages and ADVANCE/CUT/TIE badges, which hosts the Add extra game controls when a tie exists and recomputes live, flipping TIE to ADVANCE/CUT as the bubble resolves and asking for another extra game while still tied. Noted To Die keeps its 'Match N of 8 done' server flow that also advances the sit-out draw, then shows the same popup/fullscreen; To Live and Rebirth use client-side submit controls (no extra server round-trip).

REWROTE the 'Extra games' section to the boundary-bubble model. Removed the now-false claim 'Regulation totals and averages do not change.' New text: only players tied across the cut line play extra games (To Live 4th/5th within one team, To Die 6th/7th, Rebirth tied podium); players never in the tie keep their ranks and a clear #1/#2 is undisturbed; extra-game goals FOLD INTO the tied players' numbers with the exact formula in a code block: average = (regulation goals + extra goals) / (regulation matches + extra matches); re-ranking is contained to the bubble so a cut/tied player can overtake a tied-advancing player; the Rebirth final folds on points scored normally (no games 1-2 multiplier); still tied => another extra game for the remaining subgroup; fullscreen recomputes live; up to 50 extra games per stage retained.

Kept all other content accurate: no-dependencies, schema version 4, backups, cut lines (To Live top-4-per-team, To Die top-6-of-8, Rebirth podium top-3) all consistent with FEAT-002/FEAT-003. No source files touched. New/rewritten prose avoids em dashes (the only remaining em dash in README is in a pre-existing line, 'Match 1 of 8 done — draw next sit-outs', left untouched).

REVIEW FOLLOW-UP (2026-10-07-055849-review.md): tightened the fullscreen bullet to state the badge wording accurately per stage. The two cutting rounds (To Live, To Die) show ADVANCE/CUT/TIE with a goals-per-match average; Rebirth decides the podium (not a cut) so it shows FINAL/TIE with an average-points-per-game column (total points / games played). This resolves the review's note that the earlier wording implied ADVANCE/CUT in the final too, and documents the corrected final average column (previously the UI duplicated the total). README remains docs-only for this follow-up alongside the frontend fix in FEAT-003.
